title: Ensure exclusive particle rendering: mesh OR point-sprite (never both)
purpose: Prevent simultaneous draws that cause visible split artifacts by gating the point-sprite renderer when mesh shaders are active.

steps.detail: In Application::recordCommandBuffer, add an explicit guard: if useMeshShaders && meshRenderer->isSupported() then skip particleSystem->render() unconditionally. Log once per state change.
Add a bool m_forceMeshOnly; default true. Expose a debug key to toggle for bisecting if needed.
When mesh path selected, assert that point-sprite render not reached (debug builds).

acceptance: Screenshot shows no split plane; only one renderer visible
Logs show 'Mesh-only mode: enabled' once, no point-sprite draw logs while active
